title: EviGraph FinQA 300 Open BM25 GPT-5.4 Direct RAG Baseline
limitations: This manifest runs only the Open BM25 setting to control API spend before running the full three-setting GPT-5.4 LLM Direct RAG baseline.
The model is fixed in the config as gpt-5.4; the OpenAI-compatible base URL and API key must be provided through LLM_BASE_URL and LLM_API_KEY.
The baseline uses retrieval-order evidence and does not use the EviGraph operation planner, risk-aware support selection, or verifier-guided repair.
The verifier still scores the output after generation so exact match and support diagnostics are comparable to local baselines.
